name: agentcrm
description: A local first, open source CRM built for agent workflows

scripts.setup: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix apps/server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix apps/web --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix apps/extension --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.desktop: npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm start --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:repo: npm run build --prefix apps/web && AGENTCRM_DB="$PWD/data/agentcrm.db" npm start --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run pack --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/server && npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run build --prefix apps/extension
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix apps/server && npm run test --prefix apps/web && npm run test --prefix apps/extension
